title: Auto Clutch
description: Auto Clutch is a client-side Fabric mod that automatically attempts to save you from dangerous falls using clutch items already present in your inventory.
body:
Auto Clutch is a client-side Fabric mod that automatically attempts to save
you from dangerous falls using clutch items already present in your inventory.
When a fall is predicted to deal more than one heart of damage, or is likely
to be lethal, Auto Clutch waits until the landing surface is within reach,
selects the best supported clutch item, uses it, and restores your original
hotbar slot.
Features
Toggle the mod at any time with V
Activates only for dangerous or lethal falls
Searches both the hotbar and main inventory
Automatically restores the original selected slot
Client-side only; no server installation required
Separate optimized JARs for supported Minecraft versions
Supported Clutch Items
Water bucket
Powder snow bucket
Slime block
Hay bale
Cobweb
Scaffolding
Supported Versions
Fabric 1.20.1
Fabric 1.20.4
Fabric 1.20.6
Fabric 1.21.1
Fabric 1.21.4
Requirements
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
Important Notes
Auto Clutch cannot guarantee survival. Placement validity, terrain, server
latency, and anti-cheat systems can prevent a successful clutch.
The first release focuses on reliable downward-use clutch actions. Boats,
beds, ladders, vines, ender pearls, wind charges, and other advanced
multi-step clutches are planned for future releases.
